scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: A dramatic banner
scenes.caption: An advertisement on the fictional desk tablet announces an urgent update and replacement download. Reva has not opened the school’s update tool. Nikhil notices that the message asks learners to turn off protection.
scenes.speech: An advertisement on the fictional desk tablet announces an urgent update and replacement download. Reva has not opened the school’s update tool. Nikhil notices that the message asks learners to turn off protection.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: The known process
scenes.caption: The school process requires an administrator to check managed settings, plan a restart and verify the result. The advertisement has no connection to that record. A familiar product name in the banner does not establish one.
scenes.speech: The school process requires an administrator to check managed settings, plan a restart and verify the result. The advertisement has no connection to that record. A familiar product name in the banner does not establish one.
scenes.dialogue: Follow a verified route to the update.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Plan the interruption
scenes.caption: An approved update is available, but the tablet is displaying active ticket work. Reva saves the work and asks the administrator to choose a restart window. Planning avoids losing the current task without turning a necessary update into an endless delay.
scenes.speech: An approved update is available, but the tablet is displaying active ticket work. Reva saves the work and asks the administrator to choose a restart window. Planning avoids losing the current task without turning a necessary update into an endless delay.
scenes.dialogue: Make the delay specific and accountable.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: A tempting alternative
scenes.caption: Nikhil proposes using the banner because it promises a faster fix. The team compares that promise with the approved process. Neither speed nor an urgent countdown proves who supplied a file, and disabling protection is not part of the school instructions.
scenes.speech: Nikhil proposes using the banner because it promises a faster fix. The team compares that promise with the approved process. Neither speed nor an urgent countdown proves who supplied a file, and disabling protection is not part of the school instructions.
scenes.dialogue: Compare requests with the actual instructions.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Check the result
scenes.caption: After the administrator-led update, the teacher checks the managed status and confirms that the repair tool still opens. A completed download alone would not show that installation finished. The team records the result and reports any warning through the usual help route.
scenes.speech: After the administrator-led update, the teacher checks the managed status and confirms that the repair tool still opens. A completed download alone would not show that installation finished. The team records the result and reports any warning through the usual help route.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Write the decision log
scenes.caption: Sort the notices, sequence the checks and explain why the replacement download is unsupported. Stay inside the simulation. Distinguish a verified update, an unverified advertisement and an unresolved warning needing adult review.
